decisions.reason: As a newly launched Magento 2 template that was explicitly recommended on the website, it has visible recent commitment and sunk development effort, so management would likely give it more time and attribute any weak uptake to market adoption timing.

Because the responsive website template was only mentioned and not strongly showcased, it carries weaker public commitment and is easier to cut, but escalation of commitment still makes management somewhat more likely to continue than to abandon it after just one year.

Premium customer support fits closely with an information-services firm's core business, and even if results disappoint, managers can justify keeping it as a complementary offer that still needs time to build demand.

A software version management tool presented on its own page signals higher investment and a stronger public commitment, which under escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.

The standalone presentation of the data-processing-contract tool suggests a strategic and publicly visible commitment, so management would be especially reluctant to remove it quickly and could easily frame any early weakness as temporary.
